summary: Iteration 13 (backend only): POST /api/expenses payload-shape regression for the user-reported 'Save Expense does nothing' bug in the native build. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration13.py with 48 focused tests covering ALL frontend payload variants the mobile app sends: personal (no split, no group), split-equal with friend, custom shares with self+friend, group auto-populate split_with from group.member_ids, receipt_image_base64 attach + GET receipt round-trip + list never exposes base64, oversized receipt -> 413, invalid currency -> 400, lowercase currency uppercased, amount 0/negative -> 400, missing amount / wrong type / empty body -> 422, unauthenticated -> 401. Also regression-tested every other endpoint per the spec: GET /api/expenses (list, no receipt leak), DELETE /api/expenses/{id} (200 then 404), GET /api/expenses/{id}/receipt (present + 404 branches), friends CRUD, groups CRUD + members preserved, balances split-equal (100 -> friend owes 50), balances custom-shares (100 with 60/40 -> friend owes 40), balances reduced by settlement (100 split -> 20 settled -> 30), settlements create/list/delete + 404 unknown-friend + 400 amount=0, recurring create + past-dated materialization on next GET /api/expenses + next_run advanced + 400 bad cadence + 400 amount=0, /api/fx returns 5 rates with USD=1.0, /api/insights current/specific-month + 400 bad month, /api/trends?months=6 length=6 + 400 out-of-bounds (1, 25), auth (/me ok+401+bad-bearer, /session missing/bad id, /apple missing/bad-token, /logout idempotent, /currency valid+invalid), /api/scan 413 oversize + 400 empty. Result: 48/48 iter13 PASS (6.44s parallel). Full suite serial (`pytest -n 0`): 195/196 PASS in 60.87s — the single failure is the pre-existing in-memory `_SCAN_HITS` bucket leak flagged in iter12 action items (test_iteration6::TestScanRateLimit::test_rate_limit_kicks_in_at_21st), NOT caused by iter13. Backend confirmed 100% healthy for the mobile Save-Expense bug: server accepts every documented payload shape correctly.

minor.issue: Pre-existing: in-memory _SCAN_HITS bucket persists across tests → test_iteration6::TestScanRateLimit::test_rate_limit_kicks_in_at_21st flaky under full-suite runs. Already documented in iter12 action items. Move bucket to Redis/Mongo TTL for horizontal scale.

integration_issues.issue: NOT a backend defect. All 15 create-expense payload permutations pass end-to-end via public HTTPS ingress. Likely client-side causes: (a) unresolved fetch promise (no .catch handler) — verify api.ts always resolves/rejects; (b) native fetch timeout blocking without user feedback — Alert-on-timeout was added and should be validated; (c) reachability of EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from the compiled native bundle vs Expo Go — ATS/HTTPS certificate pinning on iOS; (d) missing Bearer header (session token dropped after re-hydrate). Recommend logging request timing + full response body to Sentry/console in the native build.

action_items: Frontend/native: verify Save Expense onPress calls api.createExpense inside try/catch AND surfaces Alert on network timeout (>15s). Add console.log of request start + response status + error stack to iOS console.
Frontend: confirm the session Bearer token is present in AsyncStorage/SecureStore at the moment of Save (log Authorization header presence).
Frontend: confirm EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL bakes into the native bundle (Expo `expo-constants` extra) — a missing env in EAS build makes fetch resolve to undefined URL and silently reject.
Backend (carry-over from iter12): _SCAN_HITS rate-limit bucket is per-process in-memory — flakes test_iteration6 under full-suite; move to Redis/Mongo TTL.
Backend (carry-over from iter12): server.py is 1082 lines — split into routers (expenses/auth/friends/groups/scan/balances).
Backend (carry-over): currency whitelist duplicated across /expenses, /recurring, /auth/currency — extract helper.

Test-infra: iteration3/4/5 tests write to shared TEST_USER_ID and race under xdist loadscope with newer files. iter13 uses per-class isolated users (uid+bearer seeded in mongo) — recommend backporting the same pattern to iter3-5 for green parallel runs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:585-638 create_expense: correctly returns 400 for amount<=0 (before Pydantic body-parse rejects a missing amount with 422), 400 for unsupported currency, 413 for receipt >5.5MB. Group auto-populate at 597-600 only triggers when split_with is empty AND shares is None — correct precedence. shares sanitation at 602-620 drops empty pid / non-numeric / non-positive shares AND derives split_with from friend_ids in shares so /balances works either way. is_split at 630 is True when EITHER split_with non-empty OR shares has >1 entry — matches the balance-computation contract at 903-931.
server.py:632-637 response strips receipt_image_base64 via doc.pop before Expense(**...) — confirmed no receipt leak in create or list response (list projects it out at 649). Good.
server.py:663-674 GET receipt: uses projection to only return receipt field, returns 404 on missing expense OR missing base64 — correct.

server.py:494-531 materialize_recurring: correctly advances past-dated next_run in a while loop; verified by iter13 test creating a recurring with start_date 45 days ago -> at least 1 materialized expense appears in GET /api/expenses and next_run is now in the future.

server.py:894-959 /api/balances: for shares path (908-922) it excludes 'self' and only credits balances for friends known to user (fid in balances guard). For legacy split_with path (924-931) it splits equally among (1 + N) participants. Both verified correct by iter13 assertions (50.0 for equal-100/2 and 40.0 for weighted 60/40).

server.py:596 payload.split_with default []: safe. But note that when `split_with` is provided AND `shares` is also provided, shares wins and split_with is overwritten by the friends derived from shares (line 620). Documented behavior; iter13 covered both isolated shapes.

server.py:1074-1081 CORS with allow_credentials=False + allow_origins=['*'] is correct for a Bearer-token API and eliminates the browser preflight cookie surface. Native fetch does NOT preflight so this is a no-op for the mobile bug.

iter13 test_iteration13.py::TestFxInsightsTrends::test_currency_update_valid mutates the shared TEST_USER_ID currency to EUR and reverts to USD in the SAME test — safe. If a future test class reads user currency between these two calls it could race; consider moving to iso_user.

success_rate.backend: 100% (48/48 iter13 in parallel loadscope, 6.44s); 99.5% (195/196 full serial, 60.87s — 1 pre-existing scan-rate-limit in-memory flake unrelated to save-expense).

seed_data_creation: iter13 introduces a class-scoped `iso_user` fixture that seeds a dedicated user_test_<ClassName>_<hex> user + tok_<ClassName>_<hex> Bearer session in mongo per test-class, then wipes ALL owned rows (users, user_sessions, expenses, friends, groups, settlements, recurring) in teardown. This isolates each mutating class from cross-worker races on the shared user_test_fixture01 seeded by conftest. No stale rows left in DB after the run (verified count_documents == 0 for TEST_ prefixes post-run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter13 tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration13.py and use a per-class `iso_user` fixture (see top of file) — copy this pattern when adding new mutating tests to avoid xdist loadscope races on the shared TEST_USER_ID. Class-name is used as tag so different classes never collide. TestBalances has a `_cleanup_user_data(mongo, uid)` inside test_balances_reduced_by_settlement to wipe leftover from prior tests in the same class. TestAuth reuses the SHARED auth_client (test_token_abc) because those tests are read-only (or currency-update-revert). Test_iteration6::TestScanRateLimit::test_rate_limit_kicks_in_at_21st is the ONE full-suite flake — it's caused by leftover _SCAN_HITS from earlier files that call /api/scan with truthy images before this test runs. Not iter13's doing. To green-run the whole suite, either run iter6 first (`pytest backend/tests/test_iteration6.py backend/tests/`) or restart the backend supervisor before the run. Bug RCA: user's 'Save Expense does nothing' is NOT a backend defect — all 15 payload permutations tested green through the public HTTPS ingress; investigation must move to the native app fetch layer (unresolved promise, missing Alert, missing Bearer, missing EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in native bundle).
rca_of_issue: User bug: 'In the new native build, when I click Save Expense - it does nothing!' — Backend RCA: NEGATIVE. POST /api/expenses accepts and correctly processes all 15 payload shapes the frontend sends (personal, split_with, shares, group_id auto-populate, with/without receipt, valid/invalid currency, valid/invalid amount, missing fields). Correct status codes: 200/400/401/413/422. Receipt not leaked in create/list responses. Reproduction attempt via `pytest backend/tests/test_iteration13.py::TestCreateExpensePayloadShapes -v` -> 15/15 PASS. Therefore the defect is client-side. Mitigation (E1): (1) confirm api.ts createExpense uses fetch with an AbortController + finite timeout AND re-throws/returns an error the UI can catch; (2) confirm add-expense.tsx onPress does `try { await api.createExpense(...); nav.goBack(); } catch (e) { Alert.alert('Save failed', e.message); }` — user reports 'does nothing' which strongly suggests either the button handler is not wired (missing onPress={} vs onPress=fn), or the promise rejects silently; (3) verify EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is present in `Constants.expoConfig.extra` inside the compiled native bundle (an EAS build without `expo-env` misconfiguration will resolve URL to undefined and fetch will silently 0-status on iOS); (4) verify Bearer session token is loaded from SecureStore BEFORE the create call (log Authorization header presence); (5) add a console.log/Sentry breadcrumb at button-press and again at await-resolve so the missing step is observable in Xcode console.
